doc: Per-carrier contracts, metres. Writers: humans only. Readers: assets/blender/lift_chair.py (rows tr, dq), the cabin / tower / terminal / tram generators (their rows), tests/LiftBatch (drift test vs SkiCatalog.cs, Phase B). hang_m = grip top (rope-side top of the mesh) to the lowest point; grip_top_above_rope_m = how far the mesh top sits above the haul-rope centre. Source: docs/research/art/assets-2026-10/design/dq-chair.md section 2; rows gd8 / tram: build/lift_cabin.md section 5 (ROUND-SPEC R27-R31; tram hang 10.50 replaces R5's 7.0), pasted by the gondola/tram integration 2026-10-11. Catalog Phase B (code round 2, 2026-10-11, round-2-contract.md section 10.2 with its skeptic MUST 2): schema stays 1 (lift_chair.py rejects any other); rows tr / dq gain lift_type and speed_mps and dq names its line SkiDetachableHV; rows gd8 / tram are the cabin lens rows (lift_cabin.CARRIERS; the asset gate test_gondola_tram_seams S11 compares them exactly), so their line_prefab / lift_type land together with a lift_cabin.py edit. spacing_m = the DESIGN ride spacing; the line prefab m_Spacing is SkiCatalog SpacingM. One writer: the catalog owner (humans), never a generator; mod/SkiResortMod/Systems/SkiCatalog.cs mirrors every number as a literal and tests/LiftBatch CatalogTests CT-11 compares the two.
